meta.title: Artemii Gladkov · DevOps & Backend Engineer
meta.description: Junior DevOps and backend engineer in Yerevan. CI/CD, monitoring, Ansible, Docker, PHP/Laravel.

hero.about: Hi, I'm Artemii. I set up CI/CD, monitoring and server automation, and create PHP powered backend

tech.title: Current technologies
tech.intro: What I use for infrastructure, deployment and backend work. AWS is what I'm studying now.

work.title: Silver Udochki: production infrastructure
work.intro: A Laravel web app running on my own VPS. The project is about everything around the code: how it is built, deployed and monitored.

stack.title: Containerized stack
stack.text: Nginx, PHP-FPM, PostgreSQL 17 and Kafka with background workers in one Docker Compose setup.

cicd.title: CI/CD pipeline
cicd.text: Every push runs code style checks, static analysis, tests on PostgreSQL, ShellCheck and a secrets scan. Main deploys to the VPS over SSH.

ansible.title: Server provisioning
ansible.text: The server is set up with Ansible. TLS comes from Certbot, and the monitoring host is reached over a private Tailscale network.

monitoring.title: Monitoring & alerts
monitoring.text: Prometheus collects host, container, database and Nginx metrics. Grafana shows the dashboards, and alerts go to Telegram.

freelance.title: Freelance
freelance.text: I also take small projects for businesses in Yerevan and remotely.

contact.title: Hiring a junior DevOps or backend engineer? Write to me.
